emissions.description: The fossil greenhouse gases of the materials one bench uses, before they reach Valdara's works; the scrap carries none of the burden of its first life (cut-off, EN 15804), only its collection, sorting and haulage. The carbon stored in the slats, about 40 kg CO2 a bench, is not included: product declarations state biogenic carbon apart from the fossil figure (EN 15804+A2, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol).

emissions.stage_desc: Making the bench, EN 15804 module A3: iron from the Serravona ore in Valdara's blast furnace for 65 % of the frames' iron, melting it with 35 % steel and iron scrap in the induction furnace, casting in its foundry, galvanising, powder coating and packing.

wiki.short: Park bench made by Valdara Industries
wiki.lead: The **Park bench Serra 180** is a park bench of [[Valdara Industries]], 1,800 mm long, for bolting to the ground. Its frame is of galvanised and powder-coated ductile cast iron, its five slats of thermally modified ash.

sections.title: Design
sections.text: The two side frames are cast in Valdara's foundry at [[Ferrano]] from iron ore and about 35 % steel and iron scrap. The slats come from [[Marrowdale Sawmill]].

items.description: Bench slat of thermally modified European ash, 1800 × 95 × 45 mm, to Valdara's drawing: sawn, kiln dried, thermally modified at about 212 °C, planed on four sides, edges chamfered, drilled for the bolts; left untreated, the end grain sealed.

certificate.remarks: The timber comes from forests in Upland State managed for regrowth.

properties.name: Moisture content
properties.test: Oven-dry method on samples from each kiln charge

sub.name: Moisture at the core

properties.name: Thickness tolerance
properties.why: How far a slat may be off its thickness.

items.note: HS 9401.91, parts of seats of wood, CPC 38160: the slat is delivered finished to Valdara's drawing VI-DS-SL1800, cut to the bench's length, chamfered and drilled for its bolts, so it is identifiable as a part of the Serra bench (as the spare frame is a part of a seat); chapter 44 note 1 sends articles of chapter 94 there. Sawn ash would be 4407.95 (not 4407.99, which is for species not named), and wood only chamfered along its edges 4409.29; thermal modification changes no heading (it is not densified wood of 4413).

items.description: Cargo insurance for one shipment, arranged with the insurer, at a premium rate on the insured value.

fruit_carton.name: Telescopic fruit carton

pallet.why: A pallet of 1,200 × 1,000 mm, eight cartons a layer, seven layers, strapped with corner boards, 2.18 m high: the reefer's load line allows 2.25 m, and fruit pallets are not stacked.

properties.name: Quality class
properties.why: The class the fruit is graded and packed in under the Trade Accord's marketing standard for fresh fruit, which follows the UNECE standard FFV-50 for apples: fruit of good quality, characteristic of its variety, with slight defects of shape, development and colouring and of the skin allowed; above it the ‘Extra’ class, below it Class II.

storage.why: Apples and pears keep at 0 to 1 °C and about 90 % relative humidity: colder they freeze, warmer they ripen, drier they shrivel; they breathe, so the reefer's fresh-air vent stays partly open to carry off their carbon dioxide and ethylene.

storage.why: Apples and pears keep at 0 to 1 °C and about 90 % relative humidity: colder they freeze, warmer they ripen, drier they shrivel; they breathe, so the reefer's fresh-air vent stays partly open to carry off their carbon dioxide and ethylene.

resales.note: Every resale of the world, with what the reseller paid and the freight the documents state, for the build check of decision D14 and open point O30: nobody resells below what they paid plus the stated freight and the import tax they bear, and a reseller's gross margin on the sale, (price - cost) / price, falls in the band for its kind of business (parties.json identity.legal.business), or for the kind of goods where a sale names one (band: clothing, whose margins are higher), except during a promotion, when only the upper limit applies. A price agreed for the buyer (items.json buyer_prices) is the sale's price where it holds for the sale's delivery terms (terms). Freight the buyer pays on top at cost (recharged, a pass-through) is neither the reseller's cost nor part of its price. What the reseller paid is the price its seller asks it (items.json buyer_prices, else the seller's price). Freight is shared over the goods a transport carries by their gross weight. Prices before tax; amounts compared in lume at the reference rates. A sale listed under awaiting_owner fails the check for a reason the owner has still to decide.

goods_chain.note: The goods chain of the park bench: Valdara's production record and the stock ledgers of the warehouses its goods pass through. A lot is one day's production of benches, with its date and quantity; a spare side frame carries a serial number that rises with the day it was cast (the frames of a bench lot are in the same series). Each ledger lists what came in (with the import declaration under which it entered the country, where it crossed a border), what went out, and what passed through without entering the stock (a cross-dock). The documents take their lots, serials and manufacture dates from here; tools/world_items.py checks that stock never goes below zero, nothing leaves before it arrived or was made, damaged stock (damaged: a refused bench that came back) is held apart and never sold or despatched, and a ledger ends with the closing stock it states; the build checks each despatch against its entry. Items are the maker's; a reseller's item is the maker's item it resells. Each casting day has its own melt number and pour time, and each bench lot its own coating batch: both are numbered in a running count of the year.
